title: Algites Defs Codegen vocabulary 1 keyword syntax for JSON Schema 2019-09
description: Keyword syntax only; semantic interpretation is specified by vocabulary_1.md.

x-algites-defscodegen-extends.description: Nominal direct parents of the generated object interface; does not perform JSON Schema instance validation.

x-algites-defscodegen-choice.description: Explicit Defs Codegen exclusive choice over sibling properties; minProperties=1, maxProperties=1 and additionalProperties=false ensure standard JSON validation where supported. May only appear in structural schema positions.

x-algites-defscodegen-key.description: Semantic identity constraint of a JSON/YAML additionalProperties map, scoped to the owning collection; id matches xs:key/@name, field-name matches the logical key field selected by xs:field. Does not change serialized property names.

id.description: Stable list-local identity constraint ID, matching xs:key/@name.

field-name.description: Logical name of the virtual map-key getter field, overriding multi_mapped_list_key_synthetic_getter.
